question: What alternative measures may the twice-born use to perform this rite?
premises: The rite may be performed with half of the previously stated amount.
The rite may alternatively be performed with one hundred niṣkas.
The twice-born are the agents who perform it.
inference: Twice-born officiants may perform the rite either with half the standard measure or with one hundred niṣkas.
uncertainties: The exact base measure referred to by tasya is context-dependent.
plain_english: The twice-born may perform it with half of that amount, or with one hundred niṣkas.
